mostWorthwhile.text: Growing the capillary sprout was worthwhile because its connection to the existing circulation made the wound's renewed blood supply clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The healing-skin description was confusing: it showed a continuous surface and new support while both slots were still empty.

surprise.text: The final result made clear that removing the temporary clot does not mean repair is finished; the scar's collagen continues to change.

arbitrary.text: The individual fittings were straightforward but felt mechanical, especially after the earlier description had already shown both tissues in place.

continue.text: I probably would not choose another chapter immediately. The repair sequence was clear and had useful biological details, but several steps felt predictable and offered little explanation.
